additional_info.body:
Hello,
please send this ticket to Francisco. He’s already in contact with V-Markt regarding the charger:
Hi Martin, good morning. I hope you are doing well today :)
The problem here is that we lost the signal from the Isolation Metering Device that controls if there is any potential harm for the charger/user.
In this case we shutdown the connector to prevent any problems.
In this case, we will forward this ticket and information to the Field service team, so that they can troubleshoot the error and provide a solution.
As soon as they are assigned, they will reach out to you.
Best regards,
Francisco

. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.

Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
MP / R6 170002000
Charger ID / Serial No.:
MP / R6 170002000
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
High
Handover reason: The ticket mentioned an issue whose analysis is not reported and cannot find a proof in the logs reported by the customer nor in the error flags.
As the issue mentioned is related to Modbus communication interruption, the charger has been update yesterday to v8.1.4, which includes strengthening patches on Modbus communication. Please monitor have the customer report if the issue further appears in case an onsite activity is required.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
